description: This file defines the data structures and function prototypes for managing lists of strings, including sorted and unsorted variants, with operations such as insertion, deletion, sorting, filtering, and splitting.

methods.name: string_list_init_nodup
methods.description: Initializes a string_list with no duplication of strings.

methods.name: string_list_init_dup
methods.description: Initializes a string_list with duplication of strings enabled.

methods.name: filter_string_list
methods.description: Filters items in a string_list based on a predicate function.

methods.name: string_list_clear
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a string_list, optionally freeing util pointers.

methods.name: string_list_clear_func
methods.description: Applies a custom clear function to each util pointer in the list.

methods.name: string_list_setlen
methods.description: Sets the length of a string_list, useful for overwriting existing entries.

methods.name: for_each_string_list
methods.description: Applies a function to each item in the list, aborting on nonzero return.

methods.name: string_list_remove_empty_items
methods.description: Removes empty string items from the list.

methods.name: string_list_has_string
methods.description: Checks if a sorted list contains a specific string.

methods.name: string_list_find_insert_index
methods.description: Finds the index to insert a string to maintain sorted order.

methods.name: string_list_insert
methods.description: Inserts a string into a sorted list, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: string_list_remove
methods.description: Removes a string from a sorted list.

methods.name: string_list_lookup
methods.description: Looks up a string in a sorted list.

methods.name: string_list_remove_duplicates
methods.description: Removes duplicate consecutive entries in a sorted list.

methods.name: string_list_append
methods.description: Appends a string to an unsorted list, copying if needed.

methods.name: string_list_append_nodup
methods.description: Appends a string to an unsorted list without copying.

methods.name: string_list_sort
methods.description: Sorts an unsorted list by string value.

methods.name: unsorted_string_list_has_string
methods.description: Checks if an unsorted list contains a specific string.

methods.name: unsorted_string_list_lookup
methods.description: Looks up a string in an unsorted list.

methods.name: unsorted_string_list_delete_item
methods.description: Deletes an item at a specified index from an unsorted list.

methods.name: string_list_split
methods.description: Splits a string into substrings on delimiters and appends to list.

methods.name: string_list_split_in_place
methods.description: Splits a string in-place into substrings, modifying the original string.

methods.name: string_list_split_f
methods.description: Splits a string with additional flags, appending substrings.

methods.name: string_list_split_in_place_f
methods.description: In-place split with flags, modifying the original string.
